name: @three-ws/skill-import
description: Turn an OpenAPI spec or a GitHub repository into a three.ws skill bundle (specs/SKILL_SPEC.md): tools.json schemas generated from operations, handlers.js that call ctx.fetch, a manifest.json, and a SKILL.md. Repos with no spec fall back to a declarative, handler-less bundle built from the README.
author: three.ws <support@three.ws> (https://three.ws)
